en.name: Anastasius III
en.summary: A pope of the early tenth century whose reign, controlled by the influential Theophylact family, left little independent documented record.
en.body: Anastasius III's roughly two-year papacy fell within the period of strong influence exercised over the Roman church by Theophylact, his wife Theodora, and their descendants. Few details of any independent policy or action on his part survive from the sparse chronicles of the time.
